text: FUCK! Your punk ass reflection stopped fucking copying you.
Damn, bro. You got fucking fat.
Then it kicks you right in the fucking nuts.
So you grab a goddamn hammer. Not a fucking scratch.
Sledgehammer. Chainsaw. A fucking bomb! That bitch is fucking invincible.
So you sail across the whole goddamn Pacific to get away from that piece of shit.
But you're in the middle of the goddamn ocean. Your reflection is FUCKING everywhere... and it's laughing at you.
So you show the bastard a mirror. And it can't stand its own fucking face.
Reflect on that, motherfucker. Hell yeah. Sweet!
